title: Linear two-state root-zone + lower-SWAP analytical fixed-interface oracle

model.root_state: W_r = W_r_ref + S_r*(h_r-h_r_ref), bounded but bounds inactive in RZM01
model.interface_flux: q_c = C_c*(h_l-H_c), positive SWAP to MODFLOW
model.interface_semantics: one hydraulic head H_c at fixed geometric plane; C_c is inside SWAP surrogate

hypotheses.H1: root and lower component ledgers and total SWAP ledger close to numerical precision
hypotheses.H2: exact subpartitioning is invariant for identical piecewise-constant H_c and forcing
hypotheses.H3: same H_c with different committed W_r can produce different E_c while preserving one interface state
hypotheses.H4: same H_c and same total SWAP water with different vertical distribution can produce different E_c
hypotheses.H5: for fixed parameters/window the exact E_c(H_c) mapping is affine; one tangent plus intercept is sufficient for this linear window although H_c alone is not full-state sufficient
hypotheses.H6: fast/slow timescale limits control how much upper forcing is visible at the interface
hypotheses.H7: negative controls for duplicated storage and reversed transfer signs must fail physical acceptance even if their algebraic solves converge

forbidden: no production SWAP root uptake or irrigation scheduling
no reinterpretation of H_c as phreatic elevation
no reinterpretation of condensed response tangent as physical storage
do not relax a falsified gate after execution

preregistration_correction.reason: Correct two rounded endpoint display values from direct closed-form recomputation; equations, E_c, tangent and gates unchanged.
